name: LaSOT: Large-Scale Single Object Tracking Benchmark
description: LaSOT (Large-scale Single Object Tracking) is a dedicated long-term visual tracking benchmark comprising 1,400 video sequences across 70 object categories in its CVPR 2019 release, totaling over 3.52 million frames (extended to 1,550 sequences and 3.87M frames across 85 categories in IJCV 2021). The average sequence length exceeds 2,500 frames (~83 seconds). Every frame is manually annotated with tightly fitted bounding boxes and 14 challenging attribute flags (e.g., occlusion, illumination variation, viewpoint change, deformation). Protocol II splits provide 1,120 training sequences (2.81M frames) and 280 test sequences (685K frames).
